obligations.name: admin_reactions_on_deploy_question
obligations.description: Select the message_reactions rows attached to Robert's MCP-deployment question message where the reacting user holds an admin workspace-membership role in Test Workspace, to report which emojis those admins used.
obligations.scope: reactions on the single identified message, filtered to reactors with admin workspace membership

task_spec.text: Report the emojis (and who used them) that workspace admins reacted with on Robert's MCP-deployment status question in #general.

access_plan: Locate the target message via conversations.history/search on #general matching Robert's deployment-status text; retrieve its reactions via reactions.get; cross-check each reactor's workspace membership role using users.info (workspace association) to keep only those with an admin role, then report the surviving reactions' emoji types.
